description.en: Next-gen KRAS G12C inhibitors to overcome sotorasib/adagrasib resistance
description.zh: 新一代 KRAS G12C 抑制剂，克服索托拉西布/阿达格拉西布耐药

context.en: Designing next-gen KRAS G12C covalent inhibitors with improved potency and reduced adaptive resistance mechanisms (RTK bypass, RAS-MAPK reactivation).
context.zh: 设计新一代 KRAS G12C 共价抑制剂，提高活性并减少适应性耐药（RTK 旁路、RAS-MAPK 再激活）。
